pages.preference.items.title: Items
pages.preference.items.help: Import images and arrange props around your pet. Drag the positioning pad or use the controls. Up to 16 items; GIF uses its first frame.
pages.preference.items.empty: No items yet. Add an image or drop it onto this page.
pages.preference.items.followHint: Follow the model canvas, mirror and vertical flip. This does not attach to an animated mesh.
pages.preference.items.scaleHint: Percentage of the shorter viewport edge, preserving proportions.
pages.preference.items.layerHint: Negative layers are behind the model; zero and positive layers are in front. Higher layers draw last.
pages.preference.items.pluginHint: Image props with independent placement, layers and saved scenes. Disabling hides the page and props while preserving data.
